sentences.en: However, a reserve parachute is permanently attached.
sentences.zh: 然而，备份伞是永久连接的。

sentences.en: There's no getting rid of it, unless you cut it with a knife or climb out of the harness in mid-air.

sentences.zh: 亨伯赛德警方的科林·安德鲁斯抵达了机场。

sentences.en: Paul Hollow took him aside and told him immediately that this was no ordinary skydiving accident.
sentences.zh: 保罗·霍洛把他拉到一边，立即告诉他这不是普通的跳伞事故。

sentences.en: The dead man's equipment had been interfered with.
sentences.zh: 死者的装备被人动过手脚。

sentences.en: Skydiving experts were able to piece together what happened.
sentences.zh: 跳伞专家们得以拼凑出发生了什么。

sentences.en: A long piece of webbing called the bridle connected the pilot chute to the pin that opens the container where the main parachute is stored.
sentences.zh: 一根被称为“引导绳”的长织带将引导伞连接到打开主伞包的销钉上。

sentences.en: Stephen's bridle had been cut.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬的引导绳被切断了。

sentences.en: The cut bridle on the pilot chute had been stuffed back into the elastic sleeve.
sentences.zh: 引导伞上被切断的引导绳被塞回了弹性套管中。

sentences.en: There would be no way of telling it was tampered with without pulling the pilot chute out of the sleeve.
sentences.zh: 如果不把引导伞从套管里拉出来，根本无法发现它被动过手脚。

sentences.en: And there would be no reason to do that unless you suspected something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 而且除非你怀疑有问题，否则没有理由去那样做。

sentences.en: This meant the pilot chute was no longer attached to the pin.
sentences.zh: 这意味着引导伞不再连接到销钉上。

sentences.en: When Stephen pulled it out at deployment height and let it go, there was nothing to pull the pin and drag the main parachute out of the container, so it stayed lodged in there,
sentences.zh: 当斯蒂芬在开伞高度拉出引导伞并松手时，没有任何东西能拉动销钉并将主伞从伞包中拖出，所以它一直卡在里面，

sentences.en: impossible for Stephen to do anything to get it out.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬根本无法将其取出。

sentences.en: When he realised his main parachute was malfunctioning, Stephen pulled the handle that deployed his white reserve chute.
sentences.zh: 当他意识到主伞发生故障时，斯蒂芬拉动了打开白色备份伞的手柄。

sentences.en: It launched, but all four pieces of webbing that attached the reserve canopy to his harness, called the risers, had also been cut.
sentences.zh: 备份伞确实弹出了，但连接备份伞盖和背带的所有四根织带（称为伞绳）也都被切断了。

sentences.en: The reserve parachute simply flew away.
sentences.zh: 备份伞就这样直接飞走了。

sentences.en: Stephen had no more parachutes left.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬再也没有降落伞了。

sentences.en: All this would have happened between 4,000 and 2,000 feet above the ground.
sentences.zh: 这一切都发生在离地4000到2000英尺之间。

sentences.en: Plummeting at terminal velocity, Stephen had to endure at least 10 to 20 seconds of knowing he was going to die and there was nothing he could have done about it.
sentences.zh: 以终端速度坠落的斯蒂芬，不得不忍受至少10到20秒的绝望，他知道自己必死无疑，却对此无能为力。

sentences.en: The Cyprus he had so carefully set prior to takeoff did its job, had fired, but there was no reserve parachute for it to release.
sentences.zh: 他在起飞前精心设置的自动开伞器发挥了作用，已经启动，但由于没有备份伞供其释放，一切都无济于事。

sentences.en: From the moment Stephen exited the aircraft, he was a dead man.
sentences.zh: 从斯蒂芬离开飞机的那一刻起，他就已经是个死人了。

sentences.en: Nothing could have saved him.
sentences.zh: 没有任何东西能救他。

sentences.en: Whoever sabotaged his kit knew exactly what they were doing, both in terms of guaranteeing the sabotage would kill him and ensuring it was done in a manner that it would
sentences.zh: 任何破坏他装备的人都非常清楚自己在做什么，既能保证破坏行为足以致他于死地，又能确保其方式不会

sentences.en: not be picked up by a regular pre-flight gear check.
sentences.zh: 在常规的飞行前装备检查中被发现。

sentences.en: The damage to the reserve risers would only have been made evident by firmly pulling on them.
sentences.zh: 对备份伞伞绳的损坏只有在用力拉扯时才会显现出来。

sentences.en: This action is not part of a regular check and is not recommended from a safety perspective as it could disturb the pack job.
sentences.zh: 这一动作不属于常规检查的一部分，从安全角度来看也不推荐，因为它可能会扰乱伞包的打包状态。

sentences.en: Whoever tampered with Stephen Hilda's parachute knew exactly how to hide the evidence from even experienced skydivers.
sentences.zh: 任何动斯蒂芬·希尔多降落伞手脚的人，都非常清楚如何向经验丰富的跳伞员隐藏证据。

sentences.en: Therefore, it could only have been done by somebody with intimate knowledge of skydiving equipment.
sentences.zh: 因此，这只能是具备跳伞装备专业知识的人所为。

sentences.en: A skydiver.
sentences.zh: 一名跳伞员。

sentences.en: The drop zone was officially declared a crime scene.
sentences.zh: 跳伞区被正式宣布为犯罪现场。

sentences.en: Detective Superintendent Andrews was certain whoever killed Stephen Hilda was present and watched him die.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁斯侦探警司确信，杀害斯蒂芬·希尔多的人当时就在现场，并目睹了他的死亡。

sentences.en: Police set to work interviewing everybody on the airfield, the 78 competitors and
sentences.zh: 警方开始对机场上的所有人进行询问，包括78名参赛者和

sentences.en: 20 or so others.
sentences.zh: 大约20名其他人员。

sentences.en: Every person willingly agreed to submit to a DNA swab.
sentences.zh: 每个人都自愿同意接受DNA采样。

sentences.en: As soon as they were allowed to, all of the skydivers checked their own parachutes.
sentences.zh: 在获准后，所有的跳伞员立即检查了自己的降落伞。

sentences.en: The police insisted everyone pop out their reserve parachutes.
sentences.zh: 警方坚持要求每个人都弹出他们的备份伞。

sentences.en: This was a big deal, as reserve parachutes are rarely deployed and they have to be repacked by a certified reserve packer.
sentences.zh: 这是一件大事，因为备份伞很少被打开，而且必须由认证的备份伞打包员重新打包。

sentences.en: Most skydivers are not qualified to pack their own.
sentences.zh: 大多数跳伞员没有资格打包自己的备份伞。

sentences.en: Police wanted to determine whether Stephen had been targeted specifically or if the perpetrator had targeted other skydivers.
sentences.zh: 警方想确定斯蒂芬是否是特定目标，或者肇事者是否也针对了其他跳伞员。

sentences.en: All other parachutes were checked but there was no evidence any other rig had been tampered with.
sentences.zh: 所有其他降落伞都经过了检查，但没有证据表明其他装备被动过手脚。

sentences.en: Police asked an expert from the British Parachute Association, John Hitchin, to cut some of Stephen's riser webbing so that it could be sent for DNA testing.
sentences.zh: 警方请英国跳伞协会的专家约翰·希钦剪下斯蒂芬的一些伞绳织带，以便送去进行DNA检测。

sentences.en: They provided Hitchin with a pair of kitchen scissors but he was unable to cut through the webbing so Hitchin asked for a hook knife which was easily able to cut through.
sentences.zh: 他们给了希钦一把厨房剪刀，但他无法剪断织带，于是希钦要了一把钩刀，轻松地将其割断了。

sentences.en: Hook knives are a standard part of a skydiver's kit.
sentences.zh: 钩刀是跳伞员装备的标准配置。

sentences.en: They have a protected blade, a compact, easily stowed and removed, and attached to the harness.
sentences.zh: 它们有保护性的刀片，结构紧凑，易于收纳和取出，并连接在背带上。

sentences.en: They are a last resort, used to cut through any malfunctioning or hazardous equipment, such as a parachute cord wrapped around a limb or helmet.
sentences.zh: 它们是最后的手段，用于割断任何发生故障或危险的装备，例如缠绕在肢体或头盔上的降落伞绳。

sentences.en: Every skydiver carried one.
sentences.zh: 每个跳伞员都随身携带一把。

sentences.en: This meant police had around 100 potential murder weapons on the drop zone that day.
sentences.zh: 这意味着那天在跳伞区，警方有大约100件潜在的凶器。

sentences.en: Police wanted to shed some light on the events leading up to Stephen's death, specifically the party the night before.
sentences.zh: 警方希望弄清导致斯蒂芬死亡的事件经过，特别是前一天晚上的派对。

sentences.en: Partygoers were asked to hand over video and photographs from that night to police, who spent hours poring over them, but all they found was a raucous party.
sentences.zh: 参加派对的人被要求向警方上交当晚的视频和照片，警方花了数小时仔细查看，但只发现那是一场喧闹的派对。

sentences.en: There was no sign of any tension, arguments or fights.
sentences.zh: 没有任何紧张、争吵或打架的迹象。

sentences.en: When asked for a possible motive for the murder, everyone came up blank.
sentences.zh: 当被问及谋杀的可能动机时，每个人都一无所知。

sentences.en: It was not Stephen's usual drop zone, so he wasn't as well known as if he were a local.
sentences.zh: 那不是斯蒂芬常去的跳伞区，所以他不像当地人那样广为人知。

sentences.en: Everyone who did know him or who had interacted with him repeated the same thing.
sentences.zh: 所有认识他或与他有过接触的人都说了同样的话。

sentences.en: Stephen was popular, fun-loving, and enthusiastic.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬很受欢迎，热爱生活，充满热情。

sentences.en: One friend stated, he was a good lad, fun in the air and on the ground.
sentences.zh: 一位朋友说，他是个好小伙，在空中和地面上都很有趣。

sentences.en: The time frame of his parachute being sabotaged was believed to have occurred sometime between Stephen's last jump on Wednesday and the early hours of Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 据信，他的降落伞被破坏的时间发生在周三斯蒂芬最后一次跳伞到周五凌晨之间的某个时间。

sentences.en: There were a finite number of suspects, had had to be a skydiver who was at the drop zone over those days, which came to less than 100 people.
sentences.zh: 嫌疑人的数量是有限的，必须是那些天在跳伞区的跳伞员，总共不到100人。

sentences.en: Police left the crime scene with over 200 pieces of potential evidence, and they had DNA samples from everyone present to compare against Stephen's equipment.
sentences.zh: 警方带着200多件潜在证据离开了犯罪现场，并且他们有现场所有人的DNA样本，可以与斯蒂芬的装备进行比对。

sentences.en: They were confident it wouldn't be long before a suspect was identified.
sentences.zh: 他们确信很快就能锁定嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Less than 48 hours later, on Sunday July 6, skydivers, including Stephen's teammates Adrian and David, were back in the air in tribute.
sentences.zh: 不到48小时后，即7月6日星期日，包括斯蒂芬的队友阿德里安和大卫在内的跳伞员们重返蓝天，以示纪念。

sentences.en: They all had added an extra step in their pre-flight checks.
sentences.zh: 他们在飞行前检查中都增加了一个额外的步骤。

sentences.en: The sabotage of Stephen's gear had been expertly carried out to avoid detection from a standard check,
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬装备的破坏行为做得非常专业，以避免在标准检查中被发现，

sentences.en: so now a firm tug on the reserve risers prior to jumping became part of the routine.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，在跳伞前用力拉扯备份伞伞绳成了例行程序的一部分。

sentences.en: Over the next week, police formally interviewed Stephen's family, friends, his girlfriend Ruth, as well as skydivers who were at the drop zone.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的一周里，警方正式询问了斯蒂芬的家人、朋友、女友露丝，以及当时在跳伞区的跳伞员。

sentences.en: They were hoping to find a motive, someone he had a beef with, jealousy, or a perceived slight.
sentences.zh: 他们希望能找到动机，比如他与谁有过节、嫉妒，或是某种被认为的轻视。

sentences.en: But the worst thing anyone could come up with was that Stephen could be perceived as arrogant.
sentences.zh: 但任何人能想到的最糟糕的事情，也就是斯蒂芬有时会被认为有些傲慢。

sentences.en: His mother described him as, quote, an extraordinary son, an ordinary infuriating lad, who above all else, loved skydiving.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲形容他为：“一个非凡的儿子，一个平凡而令人恼火的小伙子，但他最热爱的是跳伞。”

sentences.en: The forensics lab discovered nothing noteworthy on the vast majority of Stephen's iteMs. The slashed risers had many people's DNA on them, so it was impossible to pick out
sentences.zh: 法医实验室在斯蒂芬绝大多数的物品上没有发现任何值得注意的东西。被割断的伞绳上有许多人的DNA，因此无法从混合样本中挑出

sentences.en: individuals from the mix.
sentences.zh: 个人。

sentences.en: This was not unexpected.
sentences.zh: 这并不出人意料。

sentences.en: As well as Stephen's DNA, there would have been the DNA of anyone who had packed his reserve, as Stephen was not qualified to pack his own,
sentences.zh: 除了斯蒂芬的DNA外，还会有任何打包过他备份伞的人的DNA，因为斯蒂芬没有资格打包自己的备份伞，

sentences.en: as well as DNA of the first responders, and perhaps those who had been in the plane with him, given the close proximity in which the skydivers were packed together.
sentences.zh: 此外还有急救人员的DNA，或许还有和他同机的人的DNA，因为跳伞员在机舱内挤得很紧。

sentences.en: One week after Stephen's death, police had no firm suspects and were no closer to making an arreSt.
sentences.zh: 在斯蒂芬去世一周后，警方没有确定的嫌疑人，距离逮捕凶手也毫无进展。

sentences.en: They sent a message to all 4,000 active skydivers in the UK.
sentences.zh: 他们向英国所有4000名活跃的跳伞员发送了一条信息。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 内容如下：

sentences.en: The investigation into the death of Stephen is ongoing.
sentences.zh: 对斯蒂芬死亡事件的调查仍在进行中。

sentences.en: I am appealing for your help.
sentences.zh: 我恳请你们提供帮助。

sentences.en: Many of you will have known him and enjoyed his company socially and through his love of skydiving.
sentences.zh: 你们中的许多人一定认识他，并在社交场合以及通过他热爱的跳伞运动与他共度过美好时光。

sentences.en: someone knows who committed this vile act and I ask that you contact me in total confidence
sentences.zh: 有人知道是谁犯下了这起卑劣的行径，我请求你们在绝对保密的情况下与我联系。

sentences.en: you may have opinions or information as to how Stephen met his death was he killed if so why
sentences.zh: 您可能对斯蒂芬是如何死亡的有什么看法或信息吗？他是被谋杀的吗？如果是，为什么？

sentences.en: or would he ever contemplate taking his own life I need to speak to as many of his friends and
sentences.zh: 或者他是否曾考虑过自杀？我需要尽可能多地与他的朋友和

sentences.en: associates as possible please contact the incident room if you have any information that could assist us.
sentences.zh: 同事交谈。如果您有任何可能协助我们的信息，请联系专案组。

sentences.en: I would also like to thank the many who already have.
sentences.zh: 我也想感谢许多已经提供信息的人。

sentences.en: Sincerely, Humberside Police.
sentences.zh: 谨上，亨伯赛德警方。

sentences.en: The mention of suicide seemed to be just covering all possibilities.
sentences.zh: 提到自杀似乎只是为了涵盖所有可能性。

sentences.en: Certainly suicides were more common on the drop zone than murder.
sentences.zh: 当然，在跳伞区，自杀确实比谋杀更常见。

sentences.en: However, nothing in Stephen's demeanour suggested he was in any way suicidal.
sentences.zh: 然而，斯蒂芬的行为举止中没有任何迹象表明他有自杀倾向。

sentences.en: Witness statements and video evidence showed Stephen was in a good mood the night before and day of his death.
sentences.zh: 证人陈述和视频证据显示，在斯蒂芬去世的前一天晚上和当天，他的心情都很好。

sentences.en: He displayed actions to save his own life, not end it.
sentences.zh: 他表现出的是为了挽救自己的生命，而不是结束它。

sentences.en: This included setting up his cypress pre-flight and going through life-saving emergency procedures whilst falling.
sentences.zh: 这包括在飞行前设置他的赛普拉斯（Cypress）自动开伞器，并在坠落过程中执行救生应急程序。

sentences.en: These were not the desperate actions of a suicidal man changing his mind at the last second and frantically trying any method to save himself.
sentences.zh: 这些绝不是一个有自杀倾向的人在最后一秒改变主意，疯狂尝试任何方法来拯救自己时会做的绝望举动。

sentences.en: They were the responsible, practiced actions of a seasoned skydiver.
sentences.zh: 这些是一位经验丰富的跳伞运动员负责任且训练有素的行为。

sentences.en: Media scrutiny in the weeks following Stephen's death was intense.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬去世后的几周里，媒体的审查非常严厉。

sentences.en: His parents made impassioned pleas for anyone who might know anything to come forward.
sentences.zh: 他的父母恳切地呼吁任何可能知道内情的人站出来。

sentences.en: They visited the airfield to try and make some sense out of what happened.
sentences.zh: 他们造访了机场，试图弄清楚到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: Police hoped the presence of grieving family members would stir the conscience of someone who was keeping a secret.
sentences.zh: 警方希望悲痛的家属在场能唤醒某个知情者的良知。

sentences.en: Stephen's Black Rain teammates, Adrian Blair and David Mason, were interviewed by the press.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬的“黑雨”（Black Rain）队友阿德里安·布莱尔（Adrian Blair）和大卫·梅森（David Mason）接受了媒体采访。

sentences.en: They relived the day where their best jump ever became a nightmare.
sentences.zh: 他们重温了那天，他们最棒的一次跳伞变成了噩梦。

sentences.en: They remarked Stephen was bright, excited and in his normal buoyant mood before the skydive.
sentences.zh: 他们提到斯蒂芬在跳伞前精神饱满、兴奋不已，处于他一贯的开朗状态。

sentences.en: David felt guilty.
sentences.zh: 大卫感到内疚。

sentences.en: He had been the one to do Stephen's gear check prior to the jump.
sentences.zh: 跳伞前是他负责检查斯蒂芬的装备。

sentences.en: He said he didn't notice anything amiss and the experts agreed.
sentences.zh: 他说他没发现任何异常，专家们也表示同意。

sentences.en: There was no way a standard pre-flight check would have discovered the sabotage.
sentences.zh: 常规的飞行前检查是不可能发现这种破坏行为的。

sentences.en: On July 12, 2003, the Times reported, quote the police have failed to identify any suspects and skydivers are gripped by the fear
sentences.zh: 2003年7月12日，《泰晤士报》报道称，引述：“警方未能确定任何嫌疑人，跳伞运动员们陷入了恐惧之中，

sentences.en: that there is a murderer in their midst a few facts are clear say the police the death of steven 20
sentences.zh: 担心他们中间藏着一个杀人犯。警方表示，几点事实很明确：20岁的斯蒂芬之死

sentences.en: was neither an accident nor suicide this was not a prank gone wrong and the killer is almost certainly
sentences.zh: 既不是意外也不是自杀。这不是一场恶作剧导致的悲剧，而且凶手几乎可以肯定是

sentences.en: a skydiver he or she may strike again steven's case was a major topic of discussion because of
sentences.zh: 一名跳伞运动员。他或她可能会再次作案。”斯蒂芬的案件成为了讨论的热点，因为

sentences.en: the competition, there had been skydivers from all over the country at Hibboldstow that week.
sentences.zh: 那周在希博尔德斯托（Hibboldstow）举行了比赛，来自全国各地的跳伞运动员都聚集在那里。

sentences.en: This meant the culprit could be a jumper at any one of the two dozen or so drop zones in the
sentences.zh: 这意味着罪犯可能是英国境内大约二十几个跳伞区中

sentences.en: United Kingdom.
sentences.zh: 任何一个地方的跳伞者。

sentences.en: Many skydivers changed their habits in fear of being targeted by the unknown offender next.
sentences.zh: 许多跳伞运动员因为担心成为下一个被这个未知罪犯盯上的目标而改变了习惯。

sentences.en: Parachutes were kept locked in cars when not in use.
sentences.zh: 降落伞在不使用时会被锁在车里。

sentences.en: Hibboldstow installed lockers to take the place of the pegs in the common room for gear.
sentences.zh: 希博尔德斯托安装了储物柜，以取代公共休息室里存放装备的挂钩。

sentences.en: Some drop zones toyed with installing
sentences.zh: 一些跳伞区考虑安装

sentences.en: CCTV cameras in the hangars, and sales of tamper-proof gear bags soared.
sentences.zh: 机库监控摄像头，防篡改装备包的销量也随之飙升。

sentences.en: Three weeks later, the death of Stephen Hilda featured on the TV show Crime Watch.
sentences.zh: 三周后，斯蒂芬·希尔达（Stephen Hilda）的死在电视节目《犯罪观察》（Crime Watch）中播出。

sentences.en: Police believed someone other than the person responsible knew something.
sentences.zh: 警方认为除了肇事者本人外，还有人知道些什么。

sentences.en: They encouraged that person to come forward.
sentences.zh: 他们鼓励那个人站出来。

sentences.en: They also released a video footage of the fancy dress party the night before Stephen's death.
sentences.zh: 他们还发布了斯蒂芬去世前一天晚上化装舞会的视频片段。

sentences.en: They hoped it would jog attendees' memories or that viewers would notice something that the police had not.
sentences.zh: 他们希望这能唤起参加者的记忆，或者观众能注意到警方未曾发现的细节。

sentences.en: The televised appeal resulted in several calls to police.
sentences.zh: 电视呼吁引来了几个给警方的电话。

sentences.en: A number of people gave information about an argument that had occurred at the party before Stephen's death, but whether
sentences.zh: 一些人提供了关于斯蒂芬去世前在聚会上发生争执的信息，但

sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·

sentences.en: Hilda was laid to rest on July 31, four weeks after his death.
sentences.zh: 希尔达于7月31日，即他去世四周后入土为安。

sentences.en: Hundreds of mourners attended, including skydivers, college mates, military personnel and the detectives investigating his death.
sentences.zh: 数百名哀悼者出席了葬礼，包括跳伞运动员、大学同学、军方人员以及调查他死因的侦探。

sentences.en: Stephen's coffin was draped in the Union Jack and carried into the church by pallbearers, one of which was his teammate and friend, Adrian Blair.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬的棺材上覆盖着英国国旗，由护柩者抬入教堂，其中一人是他的队友兼朋友阿德里安·布莱尔。

sentences.en: Stephen's girlfriend Ruth Woodhouse spoke of the service.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬的女友露丝·伍德豪斯（Ruth Woodhouse）在仪式上发言。

sentences.en: She recounted Stephen's love of theatre and his many humorous antics.
sentences.zh: 她讲述了斯蒂芬对戏剧的热爱和他许多幽默的滑稽动作。

sentences.en: Her words drew laughter from the crowd.
sentences.zh: 她的话引得人群发出笑声。

sentences.en: But there was a collective sense of unease within the 300-strong congregation.
sentences.zh: 但在300人的会众中，有一种集体的不安感。

sentences.en: Was there a murderer among them?
sentences.zh: 他们中间是否藏着一个杀人犯？

sentences.en: A month later, detectives were still sure the answer to what happened to Stephen lay among the skydiving community.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，侦探们仍然确信斯蒂芬遭遇的真相就在跳伞圈内。

sentences.en: They suspected the overwhelming sense of loyalty within the close-knit group stopped witnesses from coming forward.
sentences.zh: 他们怀疑这个紧密群体内部压倒性的忠诚感阻止了证人站出来。

sentences.en: With the investigation reaching a dead end, it was decided fresh eyes were needed on the case.
sentences.zh: 随着调查陷入僵局，决定需要以全新的视角来审视此案。

sentences.en: On August 27, senior officers from across the force were called in to review the case in its entirety in the hope they would spot something that was missed.
sentences.zh: 8月27日，来自整个警队的资深警官被召集起来，全面审查此案，希望他们能发现被遗漏的线索。

sentences.en: Detective Inspector Steve Clay, now in charge, said police would write once again to all 4,000 registered UK skydivers in the hope the murderer had shared their secret.
sentences.zh: 现任负责人、侦探督察史蒂夫·克莱（Steve Clay）表示，警方将再次致信所有4000名英国注册跳伞运动员，希望凶手曾分享过他们的秘密。

sentences.en: He was absolutely positive the killer was at the week-long parachute competition when Stephen fell to his death.
sentences.zh: 他绝对肯定凶手就在斯蒂芬坠亡的那场为期一周的跳伞比赛中。

sentences.en: He said, quote,
sentences.zh: 他说，引述：

sentences.en: Our line of inquiry is that the murderer could have told a fellow skydiver about the dastardly deed.
sentences.zh: 我们的调查方向是，凶手可能曾向某位跳伞同伴透露过这一卑劣行径。

sentences.en: The person who committed this dreadful crime probably has no criminal history and is likely to be a well-educated young man with a bright future.
sentences.zh: 犯下这起可怕罪行的人可能没有犯罪记录，而且很可能是一位受过良好教育、前途无量的年轻人。

sentences.en: There's little doubt that he will have shared the burden of what he has done with a loved one.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，他一定会与所爱之人分担他所作所为带来的重负。

sentences.en: We are getting closer all the time.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在接近真相。

sentences.en: The answer lies among the skydiving community.
sentences.zh: 答案就在跳伞圈内。

sentences.en: When the UK mail-out didn't have the desired response, inquiries were taken worldwide.
sentences.zh: 当英国境内的邮寄调查没有得到预期的回应时，调查范围扩大到了全球。

sentences.en: Police took out a full-page advertisement in Skydive, the magazine, the leading magazine for the sport, asking for assistance in tracing the murderer.
sentences.zh: 警方在业内领先的杂志《跳伞》（Skydive）上刊登了整版广告，请求协助追踪凶手。

sentences.en: skydivers from the united states responded to the inquiry detailing two similar incidents from
sentences.zh: 来自美国的跳伞运动员回应了调查，详细描述了发生在其祖国的两起类似事件。

sentences.en: their homeland the first incident occurred in 1996 the sabotaged parachute belonged to champion
sentences.zh: 第一起事件发生在1996年。被破坏的降落伞属于冠军

sentences.en: skydiver kirk verner however verner happened to loan his parachute to his friend carrie hopwood like stephen hilda hopwood had a double malfunction during his jump
sentences.zh: 跳伞运动员柯克·维纳（Kirk Verner）。然而，维纳恰好把他的降落伞借给了朋友凯瑞·霍普伍德（Carrie Hopwood）。像斯蒂芬·希尔达一样，霍普伍德在跳伞时发生了双重故障。

sentences.zh: 霍普伍德头盔摄像头拍摄的视频显示，他试图打开降落伞。

sentences.en: His pilot chute floated away due to a cut in the bridle, just as Stephens would have.
sentences.zh: 由于连接带被割断，他的引导伞飘走了，就像斯蒂芬的情况一样。

sentences.en: He then deployed his emergency chute, but it too malfunctioned.
sentences.zh: 随后他打开了应急伞，但应急伞也发生了故障。

sentences.en: Hopwood's hands reached up.
sentences.zh: 霍普伍德举起双手。

sentences.en: The camera caught his chilling shouts of,
sentences.zh: 摄像机捕捉到了他令人毛骨悚然的呼喊：

sentences.en: Oh my God, I'm going to die, before he hit the ground.
sentences.zh: “天哪，我要死了！”随后他撞向地面。

sentences.en: But remarkably, Hopwood survived.
sentences.zh: 但令人惊奇的是，霍普伍德活了下来。

sentences.en: Only one riser of the reserve parachute had been cut.
sentences.zh: 备用伞只有一根伞绳被割断。

sentences.en: It should have been enough to kill him, but the parachute managed to catch enough air to slow him down before impact.
sentences.zh: 这本应足以致他于死地，但降落伞设法捕捉到了足够的空气，在撞击前减缓了他的速度。

sentences.en: The fall left him with permanent brain damage as well as pins and metal down his entire right side.
sentences.zh: 这次坠落导致他永久性脑损伤，并且整个右侧身体植入了钢钉和金属。

sentences.en: The person whom it had been targeting Kirk Verner was never identified.
sentences.zh: 那个原本的目标——柯克·维纳，从未被确认身份。

sentences.zh: 次年，即1997年，

sentences.zh: 查理·穆林斯（Charlie Mullins），一位知名且颇具争议的跳伞界人士的儿子，打开了他的备用伞包，准备换一个新的。

sentences.en: In doing so, he discovered his reserve risers had been cut.
sentences.zh: 在操作过程中，他发现备用伞的伞绳被割断了。

sentences.zh: 如果他当时使用了那个伞包，他绝无生还可能。

sentences.zh: 有许多人嫉妒查理，因为他父亲拥有一个跳伞区和一架飞机，这意味着查理在25岁时就已经

sentences.zh: 积累了惊人的6000次跳伞经验。

sentences.zh: 和维纳的案件一样，割断穆林斯备用伞绳的人从未被查出。

sentences.en: US police provided British authorities with the names of all those present at the time of these attempted murders.
sentences.zh: 美国警方为英国当局提供了所有在这些谋杀未遂事件发生时在场的人员名单。

sentences.en: They also handed over the video footage of Kerry Hopwood's fall, giving real, shocking insight into what Stephen Hilda must have gone through.
sentences.zh: 他们还移交了凯瑞·霍普伍德坠落的视频片段，这为斯蒂芬·希尔达当时可能经历的情况提供了真实、令人震惊的洞察。

sentences.en: The US police hoped a breakthrough in the Stephen Hilda case might lead to a similar advance in their investigations, which at seven years old, had gone cold.
sentences.zh: 美国警方希望斯蒂芬·希尔达案的突破能带动他们调查的进展，这些调查在过去七年里已经成了冷案。

sentences.en: But nothing came of it.
sentences.zh: 但没有任何结果。

sentences.en: On October 22, 2003, three and a half months after Stephen Hilda's death, police announced two arrests.
sentences.zh: 2003年10月22日，在斯蒂芬·希尔达去世三个半月后，警方宣布逮捕了两人。

sentences.en: They didn't release their names to the press, but they eventually got out.
sentences.zh: 他们没有向媒体公布姓名，但最终还是泄露了出去。

sentences.en: The two people arrested were Stephen's Black Reign teammates,
sentences.zh: 被捕的两人是斯蒂芬“黑雨”队的队友，

sentences.en: Adrian Blair and David Mason.
sentences.zh: 阿德里安·布莱尔和大卫·梅森。

sentences.en: News of their arrests ripped through the skydiving community.
sentences.zh: 他们被捕的消息在跳伞圈内引起了轩然大波。

sentences.en: Some condemned the pair immediately, stating they suspected Adrian and David from the beginning, and unsubstantiated rumours spread about a love triangle being the motive.
sentences.zh: 一些人立即谴责这两人，称他们从一开始就怀疑阿德里安和大卫，关于三角恋是动机的毫无根据的传言也随之散布开来。

sentences.en: Others recalled David's history of playing pranks on Stephen's parachuting gear.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则回忆起大卫过去在斯蒂芬的跳伞装备上搞恶作剧的历史。

sentences.en: In one instance, David pulled out Stephen's pilot chute, causing the pin to dislodge and the main parachute to tumble out in its bag.
sentences.zh: 有一次，大卫拉出了斯蒂芬的引导伞，导致插销脱落，主伞连同伞包一起掉落出来。

sentences.en: Skydivers had a mixed reaction to this prank.
sentences.zh: 跳伞运动员对这个恶作剧反应不一。

sentences.en: On one hand, some were angry anyone would mess around with another person's gear knowing the risks.
sentences.zh: 一方面，有些人很生气，因为明知风险还去摆弄别人的装备。

sentences.en: On the other hand, Stephen could not have put his parachute on without replacing the pin and pilot chute first, so it was more of a playful annoyance than an attempt to harm him.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，斯蒂芬如果不先装回插销和引导伞就无法穿上降落伞，所以这更像是一种顽皮的烦扰，而不是伤害他的企图。

sentences.en: David said his pranks were merely a joke highlighting the hypocrisy of Stephen leaving his kid unsupervised in an unsafe area when he was always going on about safety regulations
sentences.zh: 大卫说他的恶作剧只是个玩笑，旨在强调斯蒂芬的虚伪——他总是谈论安全规章，却把孩子留在不安全的地方无人看管。

sentences.en: after the initial anger about the arrests skydivers adopted a wait-and-see attitude one friend said quote these two are good friends and I've jumped with them many times
sentences.zh: 在最初对逮捕的愤怒之后，跳伞运动员们采取了观望态度。一位朋友说，引述：“这两个人是好朋友，我和他们一起跳过很多次。

sentences.en: as someone who knows them I'm willing to give them the benefit of the doubt for the moment
sentences.zh: 作为一个了解他们的人，我愿意暂时给予他们信任。”

sentences.en: there was also the fact that the team had pulled off the skydive of their lives that day it was an incredible feat if either adrian or david or both were focused on killing steven
sentences.zh: 还有一个事实是，那天该团队完成了他们人生中最棒的一次跳伞。这是一项了不起的壮举。如果阿德里安或大卫，或者两人都一心想杀掉斯蒂芬，

sentences.zh: 一夜。第二天，警方申请法院延长拘留这对搭档24小时。

sentences.en: The request was granted.
sentences.zh: 请求获得批准。

sentences.en: However, after 48 hours, both men were released on bail without charge.
sentences.zh: 然而，48小时后，两人均被保释，未受指控。

sentences.en: The law in the UK allowed suspects to be released on conditional police bail.
sentences.zh: 英国法律允许嫌疑人获得有条件的警方保释。

sentences.en: In cases such as Stephen Hilders, where the evidence was very marginal and police weren't

sentences.en: sure if it would get a conviction, they passed the file to lawyers who act for the Crown Prosecution
sentences.zh: 是否能定罪的情况下，他们会将档案移交给代表皇家检察署（Crown Prosecution Service）的律师。

sentences.en: Service.
sentences.zh: 服务。

sentences.zh: 律师会审查证据，并决定是否有足够的理由对被告提起指控。

sentences.en: Despite there being no charges laid, Adrian and David found themselves under a cloud of suspicion.
sentences.zh: 尽管没有受到指控，阿德里安和大卫还是笼罩在怀疑的阴影下。

sentences.en: Their home drop zone, Netheravon, told them not to bother coming back.
sentences.zh: 他们常去的跳伞区内瑟拉文（Netheravon）告诉他们不要再来了。

sentences.en: Three weeks later, on November 17, police announced another arrest in relation to the murder of Stephen Hilda.
sentences.zh: 三周后，即11月17日，警方宣布在斯蒂芬·希尔达谋杀案中又逮捕了一人。

sentences.en: An unidentified 24-year-old man from Leeds was taken into custody.
sentences.zh: 一名来自利兹（Leeds）的24岁未具名男子被拘留。

sentences.en: The arrest came two weeks after police interviewed members of Leeds University Skydiving Club.
sentences.zh: 这次逮捕发生在警方采访利兹大学跳伞俱乐部成员两周后。

sentences.en: They regularly used Tybalt Stowe Airfield and were present during the competition when Stephen was killed.
sentences.zh: 他们经常使用泰巴特·斯托（Tybalt Stowe）机场，并且在斯蒂芬遇害时的比赛期间也在场。

sentences.en: A university newspaper didn't publish the arrested man's name but did reveal he was studying at Leeds.
sentences.zh: 一家大学报纸没有公布被捕者的名字，但透露他是在利兹读书的学生。

sentences.en: After hours of questioning, this man too was released on bail without charge.
sentences.zh: 经过数小时的审讯，这名男子也被保释，未受指控。

sentences.en: His identity, as well as his connection to Stephen or the reason he was a suspect, was never released to the public.
sentences.zh: 他的身份，以及他与斯蒂芬的联系或他成为嫌疑人的原因，从未向公众披露。

sentences.en: On December 5 2003, Stephen Hilda's parents made another impassioned plea, determined to keep his case in the media.
sentences.zh: 2003年12月5日，斯蒂芬·希尔达的父母再次发出恳切呼吁，决心让他的案件保持在媒体关注之下。

sentences.en: One police officer told the press they had found out Stephen Hilda had one or two disagreements with fellow skydivers in the week before his death.
sentences.zh: 一名警官告诉媒体，他们发现斯蒂芬·希尔达在去世前一周曾与跳伞同伴发生过一两次争执。

sentences.en: Yet, they also revealed they had discovered several witnesses lied to them over the course of their investigation.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们也透露，在调查过程中发现有几名证人对他们撒了谎。

sentences.en: One witness had falsely suggested Stephen had been involved in a love triangle.
sentences.zh: 一名证人曾虚假地暗示斯蒂芬卷入了一场三角恋。

sentences.en: Stephen's teammates Adrian and David were officially released from bail, but Humberside Police refused to eliminate them as suspects.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬的队友阿德里安和大卫正式解除了保释，但亨伯赛德警方拒绝排除他们的嫌疑。

sentences.en: The third arrested man remained a mystery, but police stated a dossier on each man was prepared and forwarded to the Crown
sentences.zh: 第三名被捕者仍然是个谜，但警方表示，每个人的档案都已准备好并转交给了皇家

sentences.en: Prosecution Service.
sentences.zh: 检察署。

sentences.en: By the end of January 2004, Humberside Police had interviewed 2,500 people and still had no concrete motive for Stephen Hilda's murder.
sentences.zh: 到2004年1月底，亨伯赛德警方已经采访了2500人，但对于斯蒂芬·希尔达的谋杀案仍然没有具体的动机。

sentences.en: Detectives set up in a room at the British Parachute Association's annual general meeting on January 24 and 25, hoping somebody would come forward with fresh information.
sentences.zh: 侦探们于1月24日和25日在英国跳伞协会的年度大会上设立了一个房间，希望有人能提供新的信息。

sentences.en: The AGM was a two-day affair that included demonstrations of new equipment and talks from experts on different aspects of skydiving.
sentences.zh: 年度大会为期两天，包括新设备的演示和专家关于跳伞不同方面的讲座。

sentences.en: Being in the middle of winter, it was attended by a large percentage of the UK skydiving population, providing them with their skydiving
sentences.zh: 由于正值隆冬，很大一部分英国跳伞人口参加了这次会议，这为他们提供了在没有跳伞区运营期间的跳伞

sentences.en: fix while there were no drop zones operating.
sentences.zh: 慰藉。

sentences.en: Yet, no further information was gained from the event.
sentences.zh: 然而，这次活动没有获得进一步的信息。

sentences.en: With all avenues for murder explored, detectives returned to a theory that had been briefly raised then discarded at the beginning of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 随着谋杀案的所有调查途径都被探索过，侦探们回到了调查初期曾被简要提出随后又被排除的理论。

sentences.en: That Stephen Hilda had taken his own life.
sentences.zh: 即斯蒂芬·希尔达是自杀的。

sentences.en: Police re-interviewed Stephen's family and friends, except this time questions were focused on Stephen specifically, not on others who may have had issue with him.
sentences.zh: 警方重新采访了斯蒂芬的家人和朋友，但这次问题集中在斯蒂芬本人身上，而不是那些可能与他有过节的人。

sentences.en: They asked if Stephen gave any indication he was suicidal.
sentences.zh: 他们询问斯蒂芬是否有任何自杀倾向的迹象。

sentences.en: Army Sergeant Emile Silliers was arrested for attempted murder after sabotaging his wife's parachute.
sentences.zh: 她遭受了多处严重伤害，包括骨折，但幸存了下来。

sentences.en: She suffered multiple serious injuries, including broken bones, but survived the ordeal.
sentences.zh: 西利尔斯于2018年5月被判有罪，罪名是试图杀死妻子以骗取人寿保险金，并与秘密情人开始新生活。

sentences.en: Silliers was found guilty in May 2018 of trying to kill his wife to pocket life insurance and start a new life with his secret lover.
sentences.zh: 然而，斯蒂芬·希尔达的死亡之谜依然存在。

sentences.en: However, mystery continues to surround the death of Stephen Hilda.
sentences.zh: 他的父母仍然希望有人、在某个地方知道发生了什么，并可能站出来给他们一个了结。

sentences.en: His parents remain hopeful that somebody, somewhere, knows what happened and may still come forward to give them closure.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，所有跳伞运动员在纪念斯蒂芬·希尔达时，只能背诵他们那句老掉牙的口号：蓝天，黑色死亡。

sentences.en: In the meantime, all skydivers can do when they remember Stephen Hilda is recite their well-worn refrain, Blue Skies, Black Death.
sentences.zh: 蓝天，黑色死亡。
